dialogues.speaker: Pingshan
dialogues.text: Look, there's a stone hanging over the cliff of the Yilong Dais, like the head of a crane.

dialogues.speaker: Pingshan
dialogues.text: If you light one at the censer there, the adepti will hear your wish. Works every time, trust me on that!

dialogues.speaker: Pingshan
dialogues.text: The trip to the crane's head isn't for the faint-hearted, though. Many guests lost their composure as soon as they looked down.

dialogues.speaker: Pingshan
dialogues.text: That's why we now have a proxy service.

dialogues.speaker: Pingshan
dialogues.text: It'll cost you the equivalent of two cups of tea, but you get a wish that'll come true. Not a bad deal, right?
